editorial:
Imagine taking a new job at a remote lighthouse, thinking you just have to keep the light on and enjoy the peace. That is exactly what happens here, but things go south pretty quickly. You will feel the tension build as the main character realizes he is not alone in the tower. There is something mean and invisible lurking in the shadows, and it does not want him there. The vibe is very moody and lonely, making you feel like there is nowhere to run when the scary stuff starts happening. It is a slow burn that focuses on the mystery of the land and the ghosts that refuse to leave.

The acting is solid and makes you really care if the caretaker survives the night. You might find the middle part a bit slow, but the payoff at the end is worth the wait. If you like stories about old secrets and spooky buildings, you will love this.
endingExplained: At the end, you discover that the lighthouse was the site of terrible crimes from the past. The main character finds out that the ghost is seeking justice for those who were hurt on the grounds. With the help of a mysterious ally, he manages to uncover the truth and put the spirit to rest. Once the truth is out and the bad energy is gone, the lighthouse finally becomes peaceful again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves ghost stories and lonely settings.
